fy2023_fit_factor_validation.label: model and smear trained through FY2022; factors fit on OOS FY2023 and frozen for FY2024

shrinkage.method: empirical-Bayes precision weighting around factor 1; observation variance uses a ratio influence function and the Kish effective sample size

headline_fy2024_unfactored.label: unfactored FY2024 validation; equal and issuance weighted

definitions.formula_benefit: FSBEN; intentional engine-computable formula anchor feature, not target
definitions.observed_rate: weighted official AMTERR dollars divided by weighted RAWBEN issuance
definitions.official_error: STATUS in {2,3} and AMTERR greater than the fiscal-year threshold
definitions.probability_calibration: weighted isotonic regression; reported training metrics use nested outer/inner cross-fitting, while deployment fits the calibrator on all full-training OOF classifier predictions
definitions.stage1_deviates: abs(D) > 0.5 dollars; reconciliation anomalies are not promoted
definitions.stage2_crosses: official_error, modeled only in the stage1-positive population

oof_design.deployable_duan_smear: weighted mean exp(residual) over all full-training OOF residuals
oof_design.deployable_probability_calibrator: weighted isotonic fit on all full-training OOF base scores
oof_design.magnitude_training_metrics: outer-fold log predictions multiplied by Duan smears fit on inner OOF residuals from the corresponding outer training set
oof_design.probability_training_metrics: nested outer/inner cross-fitting; each outer calibrator is fit on inner OOF base scores from its outer training set

stage3.smear_method: deployable weighted mean exp(full-training OOF log-magnitude residual)
stage3.target: abs(RAWBEN - BENFIX) among official errors in the stage1-positive population

training_oof.method: nested outer/inner cross-fitting; each outer-fold log prediction uses a Duan smear fit on inner OOF residuals from that outer training set
